EC1: - Patient's refusal or inability to consent
EC2: - Allergy, hypersensibility [OR] or resistance to local anesthetic
EC3: - Contraindication to regional anesthesia: infection in the designated area, severe congenital coagulopathy or inadequate hemostasis before PIFB
EC4: - Severe hepatic (Child B [OR] and C) [OR] or renal insufficiency (GFR<30 mL/min)
